text:
Take a look!
The freshest ingredients far and wide.
zh:
来看看吧！
方圆百里最新鲜的食材。

text: Where do you get your goods?

Always happy to!
Everything here is fresh!
zh:
乐意之至！
这里的东西全都新鲜着呢！

text: Well, most of it comes from the nearby farmers.
zh: 嗯，大部分是附近的农夫们供的。

text:
Some folks around here also have small fields outside the city.
For them, it's a side hustle, and I can offer their goods at good prices.
zh:
这一带也有些人在城外种着小块田地。
对他们来说是份副业，我也能以实惠的价格卖他们的货。

text: But I've already heard from several that bandits are raiding the fields. If this keeps up, many will give up their land.
zh: 不过我已经听好几个人说，盗匪在洗劫田地。再这样下去，很多人都会放弃自己的土地。
